label: An Award requires an approved Decision
description: An Award cannot exist without a Decision that approved an Application (or, in funder-initiated giving, an equivalent internal approval).

label: A Payment requires an Award, typically with a Grant Agreement
description: A Payment cannot exist without an Award and, typically, a Grant Agreement -- though some funders disburse an initial installment before a fully signed agreement is in place.

label: An Installment's Payment Condition must be met before release
description: An Installment's Payment Condition, if any, must be satisfied before its corresponding Payment is released.

label: A Compliance Requirement attaches to a specific Award, not the Grantee in the abstract
description: A Compliance Requirement is always attached to a specific Award, not to the Grantee in the abstract -- the same organization can be in good standing on one award and delinquent on another.

label: Closeout requires both financial and reporting conditions
description: Closeout requires both financial conditions (all Payments made or the award formally reduced) and reporting conditions (all required Reports accepted) to be true.

label: An Amendment is forward-looking, not retroactive
description: An Amendment changes the Grant Agreement going forward; it does not retroactively alter Payments or Reports already completed under the prior terms.
